experiment.answers: the blocker every C2M receipt since T2 has carried -- 'no real open CUDA project has been run, and recognition of 2 idioms will not carry one'

kernel.origin: real CUDA source from the pinned seed -> C2M -> AIR -> MSL

headline: The corpus was already on disk: the pinned seed carries 24 real .cu files and 35 __global__ kernels, 11 files under tests/cuda_projects (sgemm, softmax, reduction, transpose, flash attention, a raytracer, ggml ops). C2M TRANSLATED 1 OF 35 AND RECOGNISED 0. Then the instrument built to avoid the PTX receipt's mistake MADE THE SAME MISTAKE.

TWO_INSTRUMENTS_IN_A_ROW_RANKED_SYMPTOMS.the_first_one_was_already_recorded: the PTX receipt found that adding the most-frequent refusal reason moved coverage by NOTHING, because a refusal histogram stops at whichever construct the parser reached first
TWO_INSTRUMENTS_IN_A_ROW_RANKED_SYMPTOMS.so_this_block_built_a_better_one: per kernel, the FULL set of constructs C2M cannot express -- checked independently, not first-wins -- then coverage as a function of supporting the top-k. A question a histogram cannot answer.
TWO_INSTRUMENTS_IN_A_ROW_RANKED_SYMPTOMS.which_reads_as: support the top TWO constructs and reach 48.6% of the corpus
TWO_INSTRUMENTS_IN_A_ROW_RANKED_SYMPTOMS.AND_IT_IS_WRONG: the curve counts the ABSENCE of blockers I probed for, not TRANSLATABILITY. Adding the store-expression check collapses it: of the 35 kernels only ONE has a store inside the T0 pattern set, and that number is FLAT at 1 across the whole curve -- supporting all 14 constructs takes construct-fit from 2 to 35 and translatable stays at 1.
TWO_INSTRUMENTS_IN_A_ROW_RANKED_SYMPTOMS.how_it_was_caught: TWO kernels need ZERO of the probed constructs and C2M refused them anyway. A curve that says 5.7% are reachable at k=0 while the frontend translates 0 of those 2 is a curve measuring something other than what it is named.
TWO_INSTRUMENTS_IN_A_ROW_RANKED_SYMPTOMS.the_binding_constraint_named_at_last: it is NOT the GPU constructs. It is the EXPRESSION LANGUAGE: C2M matches five fixed expression shapes and real kernels write anything else. C2M IS NOT A C COMPILER, and the corpus says that is the whole distance to T3 -- not shared memory, not barriers, not atomics.

a_supported_operation_refused_over_a_var.what_they_compute: c[index] = a[index] + b[index] -- the T0 add form exactly
a_supported_operation_refused_over_a_var.why_they_were_refused: the frontend hardcoded `i` in its store regex and in every pattern, so `index` and `id` did not match
a_supported_operation_refused_over_a_var.fixed: the index variable is DISCOVERED from the binding of the global thread index and the patterns are rebuilt around that identifier
a_supported_operation_refused_over_a_var.why_that_check_matters: a wider door that mistranslates is worse than a narrow one; all four run on the Apple GPU at max_abs_err 0.0

measured.tests/cuda_projects/sgemm/sgemm_shmem.cu: not recognised as tiled_gemm: the required element 'shared tile for A' is absent
measured.tests/cuda_projects/reduction/reduction_: not recognised as block_reduce_sum: the required element 'shared buffer' is absent

the_recogniser_misses_the_REAL_idioms_on.reading: the seed carries a REAL tiled GEMM and a REAL block reduction -- the two algorithms the T2 door knows -- and it matched NEITHER, failing on the FIRST required fragment both times. The real GEMM writes '__shared__ float As[BLOCKSIZE * BLOCKSIZE]' where the recogniser demands a 2-D literal, and the real reduction writes 'extern __shared__ float sdata[]' where it demands a sized array. THE ALGORITHM IS RIGHT AND THE DECLARATION SYNTAX IS NOT.
the_recogniser_misses_the_REAL_idioms_on.not_a_new_finding_but_a_measured_one: the T2 receipt PREDICTED exactly this -- 'the SAME GEMM written with different variable names or a different guard style is REFUSED' -- and predicting is not measuring. Now it is measured on code nobody wrote to suit the recogniser.
the_recogniser_misses_the_REAL_idioms_on.not_fixed_and_why: loosening the fragments to match these two files would be fitting the recogniser to the corpus in front of it, and the hazard the T2 receipt built the near-miss suite against is that a loose match SUBSTITUTES A DIFFERENT COMPUTATION. Widening recognition needs its own near-miss evidence, which is a block's work, not a regex edit.

predictions.recognised_0_to_2: CONFIRMED at 0, at the bottom of the band
predictions.top5_unlocks_under_10pct: REFUTED AS STATED -- the construct curve says 68.6% at k=5 -- AND THE PREDICTION WAS RIGHT ABOUT THE THING THAT MATTERS: real translatability at k=5 is 1 of 35 = 2.9%. I predicted the right answer and the curve I built to check it disagreed, because the curve was measuring the wrong quantity.

tier.claimed: C2M-T0 and T1 and T2 as before
tier.T3: STILL NOT CLAIMED. What changed is that the distance is now a NUMBER: 4 of 35 kernels in a real project translate, 0 of 35 are recognised, and the binding constraint is the expression language.

claim_boundary.one_project: the pinned seed's own corpus, which is a CUDA-to-Metal project's test suite and therefore skews toward small self-contained kernels
claim_boundary.the_construct_probes_are_regexes: not a parse; a construct hidden behind a macro or a typedef is not seen
claim_boundary.translatable_is_still_an_upper_bound: store-in-pattern-set is necessary, not sufficient -- parameter types, store count and pointer-ness are checked separately and can still refuse
claim_boundary.oracle_is_numpy: P2 stays open; no CUDA differential exists

AMENDED_2026-08-25_ITS_BINDING_CONSTRAIN.what_this_receipt_claimed: 'THE BINDING CONSTRAINT IS NAMED AT LAST AND IT IS NOT A GPU FEATURE: C2M matches five fixed expression shapes and real kernels write anything else. C2M IS NOT A C COMPILER, and the corpus says that is the whole distance to T3 -- not shared memory, not barriers, not atomics.'
AMENDED_2026-08-25_ITS_BINDING_CONSTRAIN.measured_since: NOT ONE computing kernel in this corpus is refused for its expression form. An elementwise AIR program needs every leaf of the store to be a pointer parameter indexed by the thread index -- a DATA-FLOW condition no parser supplies -- and exactly 7 of the 27 computing kernels satisfy it, of which 6 already translate and the 7th is blocked by fp64. A full C expression parser's yield on this corpus is ZERO. The distance to T3 is loops, shared memory and barriers, blocking 20 of 27 -- exactly what this receipt said it was not.
AMENDED_2026-08-25_ITS_BINDING_CONSTRAIN.why_it_went_wrong: the claim rested on 'store-in-pattern-set is FLAT AT 1 ACROSS THE WHOLE CURVE'. This same block then shipped the index-variable discovery fix that took translated kernels 1 -> 4. The binding-constraint sentence was written from the pre-fix number and never re-derived after its own fix landed.
AMENDED_2026-08-25_ITS_BINDING_CONSTRAIN.and_the_denominator: 9 of the 36 __global__ kernels have EMPTY BODIES -- signature/ABI probes that compute nothing, so 9 slots are unreachable by construction. The computing denominator is 27, not 35. Of its 9 elementwise-shaped kernels, SEVEN compute a[idx] + b[idx]: the corpus holds ONE distinct elementwise computation.
AMENDED_2026-08-25_ITS_BINDING_CONSTRAIN.what_survives: everything about SPELLING. This receipt's central finding -- that a supported computation was rejected over the index VARIABLE NAME -- is reproduced and extended: the index PRODUCT's factor order was rejected the same way, moving translated kernels 5 -> 6. A pattern matcher's misses are dominated by spelling.
